# n1 - ActionGraphShim: an action directory presents as a node graph

A new pure module resolves an intent directory to `:authored`, `:actions` or `:none`, and answers
`view`, `nodes` and `needs` for either shape that has a graph. Action files chain into work nodes
in file order. Nothing is written to disk.

## n1 failure-mode matrix
| Operation | Failure mode | Test |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Resolve realness | `stage_file_present?` alone returns true for an empty file, so an empty `ACTION_2.md` mints a phantom node | `action_graph_shim_test#test_empty_and_sentinel_action_files_are_not_nodes` |
| Resolve a missing directory | The shim raises on a path that does not exist, and the CLI that pins exit 1 for `no-such-dir` blows up instead | `action_graph_shim_test#test_shape_none_for_missing_dir` |
| Order action files | The sort key holds a nil for a basename with no integer and raises `ArgumentError`, or lexical order puts `ACTION_10` before `ACTION_2` | `action_graph_shim_test#test_action_files_order_numerically`, `action_graph_shim_test#test_sort_key_is_total_over_mixed_basenames` |
| Glob action files | The glob assumes `ACTION_N.md`, so the 44 other live basenames yield no nodes | `action_graph_shim_test#test_non_action_n_basenames_become_nodes` |
| Mint node ids | An id fails `NodeFile`'s work-kind rule, so a Batch 1 consumer rejects it | `action_graph_shim_test#test_minted_ids_satisfy_node_file_rules` |
| Chain edges | The first node needs a target that names no node, or the chain closes into a cycle | `action_graph_shim_test#test_chain_is_acyclic_with_one_root` |
| Parse the files section | Only an exact `## Files` matches, so `## Files to touch` yields `[]` | `action_graph_shim_test#test_files_section_spellings_agree` |
| Parse a negated files section | `## Files in hooks/ you must NOT change` publishes forbidden paths as the node's files | `action_graph_shim_test#test_negated_files_heading_is_not_a_files_section` |
| Extract paths from a files section | Only list items are read, so the 24 live sections using tables or continuation lines yield `[]` | `action_graph_shim_test#test_files_paths_come_from_tables_and_continuation_lines` |
| Emit a record with no declared files | The shim copies `NodeFile`'s absent-`files:` error, so 573 live action files read as broken | `action_graph_shim_test#test_missing_files_section_is_ok_with_empty_files` |
| Read Proven-by labels | A table-less heading mentioning `S1` becomes a label, repeating 334's false-label defect | `action_graph_shim_test#test_proven_by_requires_an_owned_table` |
| Resolve the shape | An intent holding both shapes gets a synthetic chain too, so two conflicting graphs exist | `action_graph_shim_test#test_authored_graph_wins_over_actions` |
| Ask for node records on an authored intent | The caller gets `[]` and writes the shape branch the shim exists to remove | `action_graph_shim_test#test_nodes_returns_records_for_authored_shape` |
| Keep one record shape across both shapes | The two shapes return different key sets, so a consumer still branches | `action_graph_shim_test#test_record_key_set_identical_across_shapes` |
| Answer needs for an unknown id | The caller gets nil and crashes on `.any?` | `action_graph_shim_test#test_needs_returns_empty_for_unknown_id` |
| Read an unreadable action file | The shim raises and takes its caller down mid-sweep | `action_graph_shim_test#test_unreadable_action_file_does_not_raise` |

## Steps
1. Red: the matrix's tests above, committed before any code.
2. Write `scripts/lib/action_graph_shim.rb` with `shape`, `view`, `nodes` and `needs`.
3. Green, then the whole suite at its baseline.
